name: Text as a whole
title: REPORT on the proposal for a decision of the European Parliament and of the Council on providing macro-financial assistance to the Arab Republic of Egypt
part_text:
The European Parliament wants to lend Egypt up to 4 billion euros in cheap loans to steady its economy. The money comes with conditions: Egypt must keep improving democracy, the rule of law and human rights, and the European Commission must report regularly to the Parliament on progress. The Parliament also wants the loans tied to reforms, including on migration, energy and helping small businesses.

- The loans are conditional on Egypt's progress on democracy, rule of law and human rights.
- The Commission must report yearly to the Parliament and Council on how the money is used.
- The Parliament votes on this position first; talks with EU governments follow before the loans can be paid out.
